title: Grilled Lemon Herb Chicken Bowl
steps: Rinse quinoa and cook in 2 cups of salted boiling water for 15 minutes.
Toss chicken breast with olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, and dried oregano.
Grill or sear chicken in a hot skillet for 6-8 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Steam broccoli florets until tender-crisp (approx. 4 mins).
Divide quinoa, chicken, and broccoli evenly into 4 meal prep containers.

title: Baked Garlic Herb Salmon & Asparagus
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment.
Trim tough ends off asparagus and arrange beside salmon fillets on the sheet.
Drizzle olive oil over salmon and asparagus, then rub with garlic, salt, and pepper.
Top each fillet with fresh lemon slices.
Bake for 12-15 minutes until salmon flakes easily with a fork.

title: Protein-Packed Overnight Berry Oats

ingredients.name: Vanilla whey or plant protein powder

steps: In a mason jar or container, mix oats, protein powder, and chia seeds.
Pour in milk and Greek yogurt; stir thoroughly until smooth.
Cover and refrigerate overnight (or at least 4 hours).
Top with fresh berries and a drizzle of honey before serving.

title: Crispy Tofu & Edamame Grain Bowl
steps: Toss pressed tofu cubes with cornstarch, soy sauce, and a touch of sesame oil.
Pan-fry in a non-stick skillet or air-fry at 390°F for 15 minutes until crispy.
Steam edamame for 3 minutes.
Assemble bowls with brown rice base, crispy tofu, and edamame.
Garnish with toasted sesame seeds and chopped scallions.

title: 15-Minute Turkey Avocado Wrap
steps: Lay each tortilla flat on a clean cutting board.
Spread Dijon mustard or hummus evenly across the center of each wrap.
Layer turkey breast, baby spinach, avocado slices, and tomato.
Fold in the sides and roll tightly from the bottom up.
Slice diagonally and wrap in foil or wax paper for meal prep storage.

title: No-Bake Peanut Butter Protein Bites
steps: In a medium mixing bowl, combine peanut butter and honey until smooth.
Stir in oats, protein powder, flaxseed meal, and chocolate chips.
Mix thoroughly until a thick, cohesive dough forms.
Roll into 12 equal-sized balls (about 1 tbsp each).
Place on a plate and chill in the fridge for 20 minutes to set.
